text:
sara: Hey team — customer noticed that when they apply a discount code via the API it seems to remove an existing free-trial credit on the account instead of stacking. Account id acct_9f3b. Can someone confirm behavior?

support_bot: New ticket created: INC-4021 — tagging billing + eng. :white_check_mark:

leo: Thanks. Can you paste the exact API request/response they used? Also when the trial was granted (UI vs API)?

sara: They said trial was auto-granted on signup (UI path). This is the curl they used: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/acct_9f3b/promotions" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"code":"SPRING50"}'
```
Response body they pasted: 
```json
{
  "applied": true,
  "applied_code": "SPRING50",
  "credits_balance": 500,
  "attached_promotions": ["SPRING50"]
}
```
Prior to that they had a trial credit shown in the console: `trial_credits = 1000` and `attached_promotions: ["TRIAL2025"]`. After the API call `TRIAL2025` no longer appears.

katie: Hmm. Two quick checks: 1) which endpoint did the UI use to grant the trial? (promo attach vs credits/grant API) 2) did the API call include any query params like `replace=true`? Our attach API historically has had "replace" semantics in a couple older clients.

sara: Customer says UI uses internal grants service (grants API) to add credit units, not the promotions attach flow. No replace param in their request. They just posted body `{"code":"SPRING50"}`.

leo: Ok repro attempt steps I'm going to try locally:
1) Create account test-apply-01
2) Call POST /v1/accounts/:id/grants -> grant trial (type=trial, amount=1000)
3) Confirm UI shows attached_promo: TRIAL2025 and credits_balance 1000
4) Call POST /v1/accounts/:id/promotions with code=SPRING50
Expected: promotions list becomes [TRIAL2025, SPRING50] and credits accumulate. Observed (in support case): promotions list becomes [SPRING50] and trial grant disappears.

leo: Running step 4 now...

```bash
# step 2: grant trial
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/test-apply-01/grants \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test' -d '{"type":"trial","amount":1000}'
# step 4: apply promo
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/test-apply-01/promotions \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test' -d '{"code":"SPRING50"}'
```

leo: Result: reproduced. After attaching SPRING50, the grants list still includes the trial grant (server side), but attached_promotions returned by promotions endpoint is only [`SPRING50`] and UI fetch for billing summary shows credits_balance matching SPRING50-only path (trial not counted). Looks like the billing summary aggregation favors promotions list over grants when both exist — aggregation bug.

katie: Thanks for repro. Two possible causes: a) the promotions attach flow rewrites the account's primary credit bucket, b) the billing summary query is performing a JOIN that collapses grant-derived credits when promotions exist. I'll escalate to billing-query owners + eng-runtime for investigation.

julian: Quick workaround for customers: 1) Read current grants with GET /v1/accounts/:id/grants and store grant ids. 2) When applying a promotion via API, immediately call POST /v1/accounts/:id/credits/adjust to re-add grant units (idempotent). Not ideal but avoids a visible credit drop while we fix aggregation. Also set `notify=false` if you want to avoid emailing customers during the fix.

sara: I gave the customer the workaround and opened INC-4021 with reproduction steps + leo's logs and a short video of the console flip. Customer accepted workaround for now but wants ETA.

support_bot: INC-4021 assigned to billing-team; priority P2.

katie: I'll own the triage. Next actions: add unit tests around promotions+grants aggregation, validate UI query path, and patch aggregator to sum grants + promotions rather than prefer promotions. ETA for patch: 3 business days, then QA rollout.

julian: Add note: check for race if a promo attach and a grant happen concurrently — might need transactional merge or optimistic locking.

sara: Great — please keep me posted, I shared ETA with the customer. :thumbsup:

leo: Filed follow-up PR to add an integration test that exercises the exact sequence (grant -> promo apply -> billing summary fetch). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5872

sara: Closing the slack thread, will update ticket once patch is on prod. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
